issues.description: Default speaker mismatch between TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS and documented default for v3-beta
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh' for bulbul:v3-beta, but the PR description, module docstring, and class docstring all claim 'aditya' is the default. Pick one and make the code match. Silent inconsistency between docs and code is exactly the kind of thing that bites the next maintainer.

issues.description: Spurious warning fires on default temperature for v2 models
issues.detail: InputParams.temperature defaults to 0.6. For bulbul:v2, the code does `elif params.temperature != 0.6` to warn, but 0.6 is the default the user didn't set. Conversely, a v2 user who explicitly sets temperature=0.5 gets a warning; one who sets 0.6 doesn't. Same trap exists for pitch/loudness defaults vs v3. Use sentinel None or 'was explicitly set' detection.

issues.description: Backward-incompatible removal of input_audio_codec from STT connect_kwargs
issues.detail: The previous code passed `input_audio_codec` to the SDK connect call; the new code drops it entirely with no comment explaining why. If the SDK still accepts/requires it, this is a silent regression for existing saarika:v2.5 users. State the reason in the commit or restore it.

issues.description: Speaker validation is missing despite enums and per-model speaker tuples existing
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS carries a `speakers` tuple per model and v2/v3 speaker enums exist, but __init__ never validates voice_id against the selected model's speakers. A v2 speaker silently sent to v3-beta will fail at API time with a server error instead of a clear client-side ValueError. You went to the trouble of building the data; use it.

issues.description: THREE-PATCHES: STT refactor, TTS refactor, and v3 model addition should be separate commits
issues.detail: This diff simultaneously refactors STT validation to a config table, refactors TTS to a config table, and adds two new models. Each is a reviewable patch on its own; together they make bisection painful if something breaks. Not a blocker, but the maintainer six years from now will thank you for three commits instead of one.

issues.description: Dead code: get_speakers_for_model falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models
issues.detail: The function silently returns v2 speakers for any unknown model string. Either raise on unknown models (consistent with __init__) or document why this silent fallback exists. Right now it's a special case that the rest of the code doesn't need.

review.summary: The refactor to ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig tables is the right shape — it replaces "saaras" in model.lower() string sniffing with a data-driven dispatch, which is good taste. NEEDS-WORK on three concrete issues: the v3-beta default speaker disagrees between code (shubh) and docs (aditya), the "ignored parameter" warnings compare against defaults instead of detecting explicit user input (false positives and false negatives both), and input_audio_codec was silently dropped from the STT connect call with no explanation. Speaker enums exist but voice_id is never validated against them — wasted infrastructure. Split into three patches next time: STT refactor, TTS refactor, new models. Land it after fixing the speaker default, the warning logic, and the codec drop.
